meta.name: Real-estate listing
meta.description: A three-scene listing reel laid out in HTML and CSS over interior photos: an address card and price tag, a spec panel with a stat row and feature chips, then the agent's contact card under an open-visit badge. Every fact comes from a typed field.
meta.creativeDirection: Audience: estate agents who post listings as short videos. Direction: the photos carry the mood, the cards carry the facts, one idea per scene. Scene one says where and how much: the address card rises bottom left once the push-in has started, the price tag slides in from the right half a second later. Scene two says what you get: a stat row (rooms, area, floor) and feature chips settle on the right while the camera drifts. Scene three says what to do: the open-visit badge drops in, then the agent's card with a round portrait. Push and zoom-through transitions keep the reel moving; nothing waits more than a beat. Copy comes from the fields, so the same template lists any property. Review: text crisp at 720p, round corners, nothing cut at a card's edge, the price never covers the lamp, and every layer is hidden until its entrance.

inputs.css: .wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0 24px 34px } .card { flex-grow: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 26px 34px 26px 26px; border-radius: 28px; background: $color.surface@0.95; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)} .portrait { width: 132px; height: 132px; border-radius: 66px; object-fit: cover; object-position: 40% 30%; border: 4px solid $color.accent } .who { display: flex; flex-direction: column } .role { color: $color.accent; font: 600 16px $font.body; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px } h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; color: $color.fg; font: 52px $font.display; line-height: 1 } p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: $color.muted; font: 400 22px $font.body } .phone { margin-top: 10px; color: $color.fg; font: 500 26px $font.mono; letter-spacing: 1px }
